_description: This file is generated by devel/generate-config-schemas. Do not edit manually - edit the script instead.
title: Configuration file to be supplied to `augur frequencies --config`

method.description: method by which frequencies should be estimated

metadata.description: metadata including dates for given samples

metadata_delimiters.description: delimiters to accept when reading a metadata file. Only one delimiter will be inferred.

metadata_id_columns.description: names of possible metadata columns containing identifier information, ordered by priority. Only one ID column will be inferred.

regions.description: region to filter to. Regions should match values in the 'region' column of the metadata file if specifying values other than the default 'global' region.

pivot_interval_units.description: space pivots by months (default) or by weeks

min_date.description:
date to begin frequencies calculations; may be specified as:

1. an Augur-style numeric date with the year as the integer part (e.g.
   2020.42) or
2. a date in ISO 8601 date format (i.e. YYYY-MM-DD) (e.g. '2020-06-04') or
3. a backwards-looking relative date in ISO 8601 duration format with
   optional P prefix (e.g. '1W', 'P1W')

max_date.description:
date to end frequencies calculations; may be specified as:

1. an Augur-style numeric date with the year as the integer part (e.g.
   2020.42) or
2. a date in ISO 8601 date format (i.e. YYYY-MM-DD) (e.g. '2020-06-04') or
3. a backwards-looking relative date in ISO 8601 duration format with
   optional P prefix (e.g. '1W', 'P1W')

tree.description: tree to estimate clade frequencies for

include_internal_nodes.description: calculate frequencies for internal nodes as well as tips

alignments.description: alignments to estimate mutations frequencies for

gene_names.description: names of the sequences in the alignment, same order assumed

ignore_char.description: character to be ignored in frequency calculations

minimal_frequency.description: minimal all-time frequencies for a trajectory to be estimates

narrow_bandwidth.description: the bandwidth for the narrow KDE

wide_bandwidth.description: the bandwidth for the wide KDE

proportion_wide.description: the proportion of the wide bandwidth to use in the KDE mixture model

weights.description: a dictionary of key/value mappings in JSON format used to weight KDE tip frequencies

weights_attribute.description: name of the attribute on each tip whose values map to the given weights dictionary

censored.description: calculate censored frequencies at each pivot

minimal_clade_size.description: minimal number of tips a clade must have for its diffusion frequencies to be reported

minimal_clade_size_to_estimate.description:
minimal number of tips a clade must have for its diffusion frequencies to be estimated
by the diffusion likelihood; all smaller clades will inherit frequencies from their
parents

stiffness.description: parameter penalizing curvature of the frequency trajectory

inertia.description: determines how frequencies continue in absense of data (inertia=0 -> go flat, inertia=1.0 -> continue current trend)

output_format.description: format to export frequencies JSON depending on the viewing interface

output.description: JSON file to save estimated frequencies to
